title: Scaling Symmetries and Conformal Relative Equilibria on Poisson Manifolds, with Applications to Lie--Poisson Systems
summary: We investigate conformal relative equilibria for Hamiltonian systems on exact Poisson manifolds equipped with scaling symmetries. By introducing conformally Poisson actions and conformal momentum maps, we characterize these equilibria through an augmented Hamiltonian formulation; in the nondegenerate case, this recovers the conditions recently developed for the exact symplectic case.
